text:
Maya R: Throwing this up for a quick UI/UX pass on the Compliance panel. Two pain points flagged by CS: region selector is hard to find and KMS badge reads ambiguous. Screenshot attached.

Ethan K: Nice work. Quick ask: can region default to the user's 'home region' and show a small crumb for 'served from' instead of full region name to reduce visual weight? :bulb:

Sam (Design): I like defaulting to home. Also thinking about grouping: collapse "Storage & Retention" under an accordion, and put "Region & Encryption" together above it. Helps flow for infra people.

Olivia (Security): Important: audit log language needs to be precise. Current entry "KMS changed" is too vague. Prefer: "Changed encryption key config: KMS key set to customer-managed by <user>". Also include key-id (redacted) in log metadata.

Maya R: Good call. For the small badge on the row we currently show "KMS (on)" with a hover tooltip "Uses customer-managed KMS". Any shorter copy suggestions that are still clear?

Sam (Design): Options: "Customer key" (short), "Cust. KMS" (abbrev), or keep "KMS" and rely on tooltip. My vote: keep visually "KMS" and make tooltip copy better.

Ethan K: Tooltip suggestion: "Customer-managed encryption key (KMS) 12 used to encrypt request logs and storage metadata." Make explicit what is encrypted.

Olivia (Security): Callout: we must not state that model outputs are encrypted by customer key unless it's true. So tooltip must be exact. If only request logs and metadata are encrypted, say that.

Maya R: Noted. Also accessibility: keyboard navigation currently skips the inline badge (users tab to the row then to the next control). We should make badge focusable and add aria-expanded/aria-controls if it opens a modal.

Sam (Design): Proposed markup: <button class="badge badge-kms" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-label="Customer-managed key details">KMS</button>. Also include a visible focus state.

Ethan K: Another micro-UX suggestion: region dropdown touch target is < 40px. Bump to 48px min-height and increase vertical padding. Mobile folks keep missing it.

Maya R: For retention copy, folks on support think "Retention" is vague. Propose: inline "Retention: 30 days (request logs)" and tooltip "Deletes request logs (request headers, prompts, and metadata). Does not delete model outputs or customer files unless explicitly enabled."

Olivia (Security): Audit log canonical verbs: use present simple and include machine tags. Examples: "Set retention: 30 days (request_logs) by Maya R". Add tags: action=retention.set,target=request_logs,value=30,method=ui. audit-bot: can we auto-populate those tags?

audit-bot: Audit schema: tags will be generated by backend when action types are emitted. Recommend using canonical verbs from /docs/audit/schema-v2.

Sam (Design): Contrast check: current badge text color on token `accent-600` vs bg `surface-0` is 3.0:1 at 12px (fails AA small). Let's move badge bg to `accent-700` or text to `text-0`. Also tooltips are using 11px. bump to 12px as min.

Ethan K: Can we also change the KMS tooltip title to bold so it reads better on quick scan? Small affordance improvement.

Maya R: Action items: Sam 12 update mock with grouping and accessible badge + focus ring; Ethan 12 bump touch targets and update tooltip hierarchy; Olivia 12 draft exact audit log phrasings and required metadata fields; I'll consolidate and run one more pass tomorrow morning.

Olivia (Security): One more: add a small help-link under KMS badge "What does customer-managed key encrypt?" linking to docs. Helps avoid overclaiming.

Maya R: Great point, will include link in tooltip and a small inline anchor in the expanded modal.

audit-bot: Accessibility quickscan results attached: /reports/1809994321/kms-badge-contrast.csv, /reports/1809994321/region-touch-targets.csv

Sam (Design): I'll upload new figma in ~45m, pinging thread when done. :female-technologist:

Ethan K: Thanks all, will queue the frontend changes once figma is up.

Maya R: Thanks team. Follow-up review tomorrow 10:30am PT. :calendar:
